title: Indexed read from a constant std_logic_vector array
sourceUrl: internal: Kmila constant-array indexing regression test
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: 8-entry constant std_logic_vector array indexed each clock by an external 3-bit addr. data should reflect rom_init(addr) one cycle after addr changes. Tests whether Kmila stores constant array literals as discrete 8-bit slots (correct) vs concatenated with padding (the suspected bug surfaced by case 121).
